title: V9 courses: the same views in the V9 and V10 builds (world-up cameras, race frozen on the grid)

views.label: pelagos skim (#400)
views.js: () => { const t = __game.scene.track, D = t.D, I = 400, P = (s, x, y) => { const i = Math.floor(s), u = s - i, a = t.pointAt(((i % t.N) + t.N) % t.N, x, y), b = t.pointAt((((i + 1) % t.N) + t.N) % t.N, x, y); return [a.x + (b.x - a.x) * u, a.y + (b.y - a.y) * u, a.z + (b.z - a.z) * u]; }; return { pos: P(I - 12.000000 / D, 0.000000, 4.000000), at: P(I + 18.000000 / D, 0.000000 * 0.3, 4.000000 * 0.3), fov: 70.000000 }; }
